description: Database view exposing top5 salesman secondary sales data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report top5 salesman secondary sales records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the top5 salesman secondary sales view.

columns.name: SalesmanId
columns.description: Salesman id of the top5 salesman secondary sales.

columns.name: Salesman
columns.description: Salesman of the top5 salesman secondary sales.

columns.name: TotalSalesQuantity
columns.description: Total sales quantity of the top5 salesman secondary sales.

business_rules: Use TotalSalesQuantity for monetary or quantity totals.
VW_Top5SalesmanSecondarySales is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Count of top5 salesman secondary sales

known_issues: TotalSalesQuantity is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name VW_Top5SalesmanSecondarySales (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(TotalSalesQuantity) for totals of total sales quantity.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
